briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI timelines amid compute crunch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments scramble for compute controls. Global AI investment surges past $11B this quarter as safety gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with extended reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek R2 matches GPT-5 performance at 40% lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive CAN bus deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units monthly; Microsoft and xAI announce 200k H200 cluster expansions in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory compute caps slow US labs more than Chinese competitors by Q4 2026?
